features.name: Disable Metrics Reporting
features.tooltip: Stops Brave from sending anonymous usage and crash reports.

features.name: Disable Safe Browsing Reporting
features.tooltip: Stops Brave from sending extended Safe Browsing data back to servers.

features.name: Disable URL Data Collection
features.tooltip: Stops sending anonymized URLs to help improve the browser.

features.name: Disable Feedback Surveys
features.tooltip: Disables proactive feedback survey prompts.

features.name: Disable P3A Telemetry
features.tooltip: Disables Privacy-Preserving Product Analytics completely.

features.name: Disable Daily Stats Ping
features.tooltip: Stops the daily active user ping.

features.name: Disable Web Discovery
features.tooltip: Prevents anonymous search/browsing data from being sent to Brave Search.

features.name: Disable Autofill (Addresses)
features.tooltip: Disables saving and autofilling addresses.

features.name: Disable Autofill (Credit Cards)
features.tooltip: Disables saving and autofilling credit cards.

features.name: Disable Password Manager
features.tooltip: Disables the built-in password manager.

features.name: Disable Browser Sign-in
features.tooltip: Prevents syncing your data to cloud accounts.

features.name: Disable WebRTC IP Leak
features.tooltip: Prevents your real IP address from leaking when using a VPN.

features.name: Disable QUIC Protocol
features.tooltip: Forces standard TCP, stopping UDP firewall bypasses and tracking.

features.name: Block Third Party Cookies
features.tooltip: Blocks all third-party tracking cookies.

features.name: Enable Do Not Track
features.tooltip: Sends a Do Not Track request with your browsing traffic.

features.name: Enable Global Privacy Control
features.tooltip: Enables GPC to tell sites not to sell or share your data.

features.name: Enable De-AMP
features.tooltip: Bypasses Google AMP pages and redirects you to the original website.

features.name: Enable Debouncing
features.tooltip: Skips known tracking redirect hops before you reach your destination.

features.name: Strip URL Trackers
features.tooltip: Automatically removes tracking parameters from URLs.

features.name: Reduce Language Fingerprinting
features.tooltip: Reduces the language data sent to sites to prevent fingerprinting.

features.name: Force Google SafeSearch
features.tooltip: Filters explicit search results.

features.name: Disable IPFS
features.tooltip: Stops peer-to-peer background connections to unknown nodes.

features.name: Force Incognito Mode
features.tooltip: Forces the browser to always open in Incognito Mode.

features.name: Force Download Prompts
features.tooltip: Forces Brave to ask where to save a file before downloading, preventing drive-by downloads.

features.name: Clear Data on Exit
features.tooltip: Wipes all cookies, cache, and browsing history the moment the browser closes.

features.name: Force HTTPS-Only Mode
features.tooltip: Strictly upgrades all connections to HTTPS and blocks unencrypted HTTP traffic.

features.name: Disable Brave Rewards
features.tooltip: Completely disables the Brave Crypto Rewards system.

features.name: Disable Brave Wallet
features.tooltip: Disables the built-in Brave Crypto Wallet.

features.name: Disable Brave VPN
features.tooltip: Removes the Brave VPN integration and prompts.

features.name: Disable Brave AI Chat
features.tooltip: Disables Brave Leo (AI Chat) integration.

features.name: Disable Tor
features.tooltip: Disables built-in Tor window support.

features.name: Disable Sync
features.tooltip: Disables Brave Sync functionality across devices.

features.name: Disable Brave News
features.tooltip: Removes the Brave News feed bloat from the New Tab page.

features.name: Disable Brave Talk
features.tooltip: Removes the built-in video calling integration.

features.name: Disable Speedreader
features.tooltip: Completely disables the Speedreader feature, reader mode, and automatic prompts.

features.name: Disable Wayback Machine Prompts
features.tooltip: Stops Brave from asking to search the Internet Archive when you hit a 404 error.

features.name: Disable Background Mode
features.tooltip: Prevents extensions/apps from running after the browser is closed.

features.name: Disable Media Recommendations
features.tooltip: Disables media recommendations to save memory.

features.name: Disable Shopping List
features.tooltip: Disables the shopping list feature.

features.name: Always Open PDF Externally
features.tooltip: Forces PDFs to download and open in your system viewer instead of the browser.

features.name: Disable Translate
features.tooltip: Disables automatic translation prompts.

features.name: Disable Spellcheck
features.tooltip: Disables the built-in spellchecker to save CPU cycles.

features.name: Disable Promotions
features.tooltip: Disables Brave promotional notifications.

features.name: Disable Search Suggestions
features.tooltip: Disables predictive search suggestions in the URL bar.

features.name: Disable Printing
features.tooltip: Disables the browser print function.

features.name: Disable Default Browser Prompt
features.tooltip: Stops Brave from asking to be the default browser.

features.name: Disable Developer Tools
features.tooltip: Disables F12 / Inspect Element.

features.name: Disable Brave Playlist
features.tooltip: Removes the Brave Playlist media feature.

permissions.name: Location
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to request your physical location.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to record video via your webcam.

permissions.name: Microphone
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to record audio via your microphone.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to send you native desktop push notifications.

permissions.name: JavaScript
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to run interactive scripts. Blocking this breaks almost all websites.

permissions.name: Images
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to load and display images.

permissions.name: Pop-ups and Redirects
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to open new windows or redirect you without your input.

permissions.name: USB Devices
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to request direct connection to your plugged-in USB devices.

permissions.name: Serial Ports
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to request connection to hardware via serial ports.

permissions.name: HID Devices
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to request access to Human Interface Devices (e.g. controllers).

permissions.name: File Editing
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to read and save files directly to your local file system.

permissions.name: Clipboard
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to read text and images copied to your clipboard.

permissions.name: Window Management
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to open windows on specific monitors or in fullscreen.

permissions.name: Local Fonts
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to fingerprint your device based on locally installed fonts.

permissions.name: Payment Handlers
permissions.tooltip: Allows sites to check if you have local payment apps installed.
